title: Outdoor Braised Australian Lamb Stew
description: A rich and hearty one-pot Australian dish featuring tender lamb, onions, and a blend of spices, perfect for a cold evening outdoors, this low-fat-friendly stew is made with lean lamb and minimal oil.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, carrots, and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, red wine, beef broth, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven, where it will cook at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 2.5 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
